blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all five views and six poses shows the overskirt still reads as a smooth flared shell; the six sewn pleats are not legible at product-view scale, with only faint irregular facets. Independent Astra review concurs.

Reducing the forward apron projection from 10 mm to 4 mm reduces the broad front protrusion, but left/right side views still show a hard projecting step at the skirt attachment. The waist transition remains detached-looking.

Crouch retains large triangular overlaps and a dangling rear panel; sit gathers into rigid layered slabs around the thighs with exposed rear tabs; prone has broad petal-like hip/hem lobes. Pose response remains visually incoherent.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
